core: 无 is a formal, literary way to say 'have no / without', used in fixed common phrases rather than casual daily speech. Learners often overuse it in informal conversation, where 没有 sounds far more natural.

sentences.situation: At home · talking to your roommate
sentences.zh: 周末没什么事做，好无聊。
sentences.pinyin: zhōumò méi shénme shì zuò, hǎo wúliáo.
sentences.en: There's nothing to do on the weekend, it's so boring.
sentences.why: You say this to someone you live with when you have no plans and feel unoccupied. 无聊 is the most common everyday use of 无 in casual speech.
sentences.tip: Don't say 我无liáo in formal settings; use 没有意思 for a softer, more neutral tone.

sentences.situation: At work · talking to a colleague
sentences.zh: 这个项目跟我无关，我不参加。
sentences.pinyin: zhège xiàngmù gēn wúguān, wǒ bù cānjiā.
sentences.en: This project has nothing to do with me, I won't join.
sentences.why: You use this to draw a boundary between your responsibilities and someone else's task. It sounds firm but not aggressive.
sentences.tip: Add 大概 before 跟我无关 if you want to soften the boundary.

sentences.situation: At a restaurant · talking to a friend
sentences.pinyin: nǐ xiǎng chī shénme? wǒ wúsuǒwèi.
sentences.en: What do you want to eat? I don't mind.
sentences.why: You say this when you have no strong preference and want the other person to choose. It is extremely common in daily social plans.
sentences.tip: Said with a flat tone it can sound annoyed; add 都可以 to sound warmer.

sentences.situation: At a shop · talking to the cashier
sentences.zh: 这个东西有没有无理由退货的服务？
sentences.pinyin: zhège dōngxi yǒu méiyǒu wúlǐyóu tuìhuò de fúwù?
sentences.en: Does this item come with a no-reason return policy?
sentences.why: You ask this before buying something to make sure you can return it if you change your mind. 无理由 is a standard retail phrase in China.
sentences.tip: Shorten it to 可以无理由退吗? for a faster, more natural question.

sentences.situation: At work · talking to your team lead
sentences.zh: 无论遇到什么困难，我们都要按时完成这个任务。
sentences.pinyin: wúlùn yùdào shénme kùnnán, wǒmen dōu yào ànshí wánchéng zhège rènwù.
sentences.en: No matter what difficulties we run into, we must finish this task on time.
sentences.why: You say this to set a clear, non-negotiable standard for your team. 无论 makes the statement sound more decisive than a casual 不管.
sentences.tip: This is appropriate for work; don't use 无论 with close friends, 不管 sounds more relaxed.

sentences.situation: With a friend · comforting them after a small setback
sentences.zh: 失败了也没关系，失败是成功之母嘛。
sentences.pinyin: shībài le yě méiguānxi, shībài shì chénggōng zhī mǔ ma.
sentences.en: It's okay to have failed; failure is the mother of success, after all.
sentences.why: You use this common saying to cheer up a friend who feels down. It softens the blow by framing failure as a normal, useful step.
sentences.tip: Add a small laugh after 嘛 to make it feel less preachy.

sentences.situation: At a meeting · responding to a client
sentences.zh: 我们可以无条件支持你们的合理需求。
sentences.pinyin: wǒmen kěyǐ wútiáojiàn zhīchí nǐmen de hélǐ xūqiú.
sentences.en: We can provide unconditional support for your reasonable requests.
sentences.why: You say this to a client to build trust. 无条件 signals you are flexible and will not nickel-and-dime them on basic needs.
sentences.tip: Pair this with a smile; otherwise it can sound too formal and distant.

sentences.situation: At home · talking to your family
sentences.zh: 无论你想去哪里旅行，我都陪你去。
sentences.pinyin: wúlùn nǐ xiǎng qù nǎlǐ lǚxíng, wǒ dōu péi nǐ qù.
sentences.en: No matter where you want to travel, I will go with you.
sentences.why: You say this to a family member you care about to show you will always be there for them. It sounds sincere rather than stiff.
sentences.tip: Add 都可以 to the end if you want to sound more casual.

sentences.situation: At work · WeChat message to your colleague
sentences.zh: 这个方案对我来说无所谓，你觉得好就行。
sentences.pinyin: zhège fāng'àn duì wǒ láishuō wúsuǒwèi, nǐ juéde hǎo jiù xíng.
sentences.en: I don't really mind this plan; as long as you think it's good, it's fine.
sentences.why: You send this to a colleague to say you defer to their judgment. It avoids unnecessary debate and sounds collaborative.
sentences.tip: If you actually do care, don't use 无所谓; it will make people think you are checked out.

sentences.situation: On the phone · talking to a customer service agent
sentences.zh: 我买这个产品的时候，你们说过有无条件售后的。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ mǎi zhège chǎnpǐn de shíhòu, nǐmen shuō guò yǒu wútiáojiàn shòuhòu de.
sentences.en: When I bought this product, you said it came with unconditional after-sales service.
sentences.why: You use this to remind the service agent of their original promise when you are having a problem. It is a gentle but clear way to push for a solution.
sentences.tip: Slow down on 无条件 to emphasize you remember their guarantee.

quiz.prompt: You are hanging out with a friend on a rainy weekend, with nothing to do. Tell them you feel really bored.
quiz.answer: 今天下雨没事做，好无聊啊。
accept: 周末没什么事，真的好无聊。
quiz.explain: 无聊 is the natural casual word for feeling bored with nothing to do, perfect for chatting with a friend.

quiz.prompt: A friend asks where you want to go for dinner. You have no preference and want them to choose.
quiz.answer: 我无所谓，你选地方就好。
quiz.explain: 无所谓 is the standard way to say you don't mind in everyday social plans.

quiz.prompt: Your boss asks if you can join a new project that is not part of your job. Politely say this project is unrelated to you and you cannot join.
quiz.answer: 不好意思，这个项目跟我无关，我手上还有别的工作要做。
accept: 抱歉，这个项目跟我无关，我暂时没法参加。
不好意思，这跟我无关，我手头的事还没做完。
quiz.explain: Using 跟我无关 draws a clear, polite boundary without sounding rude to your boss.

quiz.prompt: You are talking to your team, and want to say no matter what problems we meet, we will finish the work on time. Use 无论.
quiz.answer: 无论遇到什么问题，我们都要按时完成工作。
accept: 无论有什么困难，我们都得按时把事做完。
无论出什么问题，我们都要按时完成任务。
quiz.explain: 无论 is the formal, decisive way to set a firm team standard in a work setting.

quiz.prompt: 朋友问你：「周末我们去吃火锅还是吃日料？」 你完全没有偏好，让他随便选就好。
quiz.answer: 我无所谓，你想吃什么就去吃什么。
accept: 我都无所谓，你决定就好。
我无所谓，你选哪个都行。
quiz.explain: 用 无所谓 回答朋友的选择问题，是最自然的表示自己没有偏好的方式。

quiz.prompt: 你给客服打电话，提醒对方你买产品时他们承诺过无条件售后，现在产品出了问题需要解决。
quiz.answer: 我买这个产品的时候，你们说过有无条件售后的，现在出了问题麻烦帮我处理一下。
accept: 当时你们说过这个产品有 unconditional 售后，现在坏了请帮我解决。
你们之前承诺过无条件售后，现在产品出问题了，麻烦帮忙看看。
quiz.explain: 用 无条件售后 提醒对方之前的承诺，是礼貌但坚定地推动解决问题的方式。
